$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: A snapshot missing required fields is rejected atomically by the schema

rejection.rule: V2 objects are closed: missing required fields reject the whole object. The phone retains the last valid projection. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §2, §6; protocol-v2.schema.json coachingState)
rejection.effect: The malformed snapshot does not switch wire mode or mutate any lane. The last valid projection and revision remain unchanged.

summary: A coaching_state_v2 object missing stateRevision and sessionId fails schema validation. The phone MUST NOT apply it and MUST NOT emit a competing projection.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: Required fields sessionId and stateRevision are absent. The closed v2 object is rejected by the schema; the phone retains the last valid projection (the accepted session, no prior coaching state). (PROTOCOL_V2.md §2, §6)

outcome: The malformed snapshot is rejected atomically. No lane is applied; no protocol-owned revision is allocated.
